body.x: IS Communications (www.iscon.co.kr), an exhibit support company of Daegu Mobile Convergence Center, unveiled its electronic bulletin board 'U-Pointer' in '2013 International Consumer Electronics Show , CES 2013 held at US, Las Vegas, from Jan.8, 2013 to Jan.11

'U-Pointer' has no time restraints with pen gesture recognition that it leads to quick and detailed writing on the black board. Also it has advantages that you can write and paint with high reaction velocity and degree of precision. In addition it provides handy manual that you can connect USB cable to the compact-sized desktop and display has no restriction for its screen proportion.

Meanwhile, Daegu Mobile Convergence Center will help 9 domestic mobile IT convergence companies booth lease and facility devices, counseling and interpretation, production shipping, product directory book, as part of national project 'New Industry Mobile Convergence global competitiveness reinforcement.
